{{Quote|I'm from Generation Five Thousand. Is that your Generation, too?''"<br />"''Uh, yeah.|9779 and Boba Fett|<ref name="MoD">''[[Boba Fett: Maze of Deception]]''</ref>}}
'''Generation Five Thousand''' was a Generation of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]<ref name="MoD" /> created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] to be used to fight for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="CloneDB">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]</ref> [[Clone cadet/Legends|Clone cadet]] [[9779]] was a member of Generation Five Thousand.<ref name="MoD" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Boba Fett: Maze of Deception]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> while stationed on the planet [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]], 9779 crossed paths with [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], a fellow [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who became the [[Clone template/Legends|genetic source]] for the clones of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Unbeknownst to 9779 though, the [[Youngling/Legends|young]] Boba was not a [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]] of the Republic's [[Army/Legends|army]], but rather a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. 9779 introduced himself to Boba, who in turn responded with the alias 1313. 9779 then asked if he was also part of Generation Five Thousand, to which Boba lied and answered yes.<ref name="MoD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Generation Five Thousand appeared in the [[2003]] novel written by [[Elizabeth Hand]], ''[[Boba Fett: Maze of Deception]]'', the third installment in the [[Star Wars: Boba Fett (novel series)|''Boba Fett'']] novel series.<ref name="MoD" />
